title: GMC Jimmy Engines by Year (1970–2005)
description: Every factory engine in the GMC Jimmy by year: the full-size K5 Jimmy's sixes, V8s and 6.2 diesel, and the compact S-15 Jimmy's fours, V6s and Typhoon turbo.
intro: GMC used the Jimmy name on two SUVs: the full-size K5 Jimmy of 1970–1991, GMC's version of the K5 Blazer, and the compact S-15 Jimmy of 1983–2005, GMC's version of the S-10 Blazer. The 1992–1993 Typhoon was a turbocharged all-wheel-drive Jimmy.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: Full-size K5 Jimmy
intro: The full-size Jimmy shared Chevrolet's 250 six, small-block V8s and 400, the 6.2 diesel from 1982, and the 5.7 to the end. Ratings are SAE net from 1972.

generations.name: S-15 Jimmy
intro: The compact Jimmy used GM's 2.0 and 2.5 fours and 2.8 and 4.3 V6s; the 1992–1993 Typhoon had a turbocharged 4.3.
The redesigned compact Jimmy used the 4.3 Vortec V6.
